content.text: : cortisol, as well as other steroid hormones, binds to intracell receptors – the steroid-receptor complex enters the nucleus and acts as a transcription factor to turn on certain genes, causing synth of specific proteins which are responsible for its physiological actions
Increases BG, increases protein catabolism from musc/bone, antagonist of insulin
Inhibits #/activity of cells involved in inflam response
Inhibits his release from mast cells
Mineralocorticoid effects: salt/H2O retention, potassium loss
•Replace therapy: AI (Addison's dz) and CAH (defects in enzymes for steroid hormone synth)
•Dexamethasone suppression test (DST): dx of Cushing’s syndrome
•Tx of chronic inflam dz:  RA, UC, asthma, SLE, eye and skin inflam
•Tx of allergic rxns: drug, serum, and transfusion rxns
•IS: prev of graft reject after transplantation
: ↑appetite/wt gain, fluid retention, emotional instability, insomnia, indigestion, bitter taste, ↑BP/BG

: osteoporosis, GI (ulceration, bleed), psychiatric (mood, psychosis), cataracts, glaucoma, CV (HTN, edema, hypokalemia), diabetes, hyperlipidemia, Cushingoid syndrome, growth failure, impaired wound heal, adrenal suppression, IS
Clin Use: used mainly for anti-inflam effects as first line agents for relief of sxs in chronic inflam dz states
•RA, acute gouty arthritis, acute ankylosing spondylitis, OA

: GI (irritate, gastritis, PUD, bleed), ↑bleed time, ↓GFR, ischemia, acute renal failure, salt/H2O retention, CHF risk, rash, SJS, asthmatics (bronchospasm, dyspnea, wheezing), aseptic meningitis, exacerbation of anemia, rebound HA
: irreversible inhibition of both COX1 & COX2

: GI irritate, erosive gastritis, ↑bleed time, gastric ulceration/bleed, salicylism (tinnitus, deafness, HA, confusion, ↑pulse & RRs), hypervent, resp alkalosis, hypersensitivity (rash, SJS/TEN), Reyes syndrome (fulminating hepatitis w/ cerebral edema)
: GI bleed/ulcerations, CNS (HA, vertigo, confusion), blood dyscrasias (neutropenia, thrombocytopenia)
: serious GI toxicity, edema, HA, dizziness, rash, severe skin rxns
: OA, RA, juvenile RA, acute pain, primary dysmenorrhea, ankylosing spondylitis
: pts w/ ASA triad; sulfa allergy
•use w/ great caution or ⍉@ all in pts w/ chronic renal failure, severe Hdz, & hepatic failure
•reserve use for pts @ highest risk of NSAID-induced gastropathy
•nephrotoxicity, greater prothrombotic effect, ↓incidence of GI bleed/ulcers
